# Jacob C. Smith

> Data scientist and ML engineer based in Buckhannon, West Virginia,
> transitioning from seven years of enterprise sales and account management
> into applied analytics and machine learning via the NewForce Cohort 11 data
> science program. Tagline: "I turn messy, high-dimensional data into
> decisions and systems that ship." Has shipped the WVRTP facility inspection
> system for Readyfuels (https://readyfuels.com) and the Hermes plugin for
> Nous Research (https://nousresearch.com). Open to full-time Data Scientist /
> ML Engineer roles.

## Background
- 2021–2022: Outside Sales Representative, Cole Truck Parts

## Data Science & ML Projects
- CONSIM: GPU-accelerated framework for real-time pattern detection in
  high-dimensional time-series data. 20x performance uplift via CUDA/PyTorch
  and JAX; phase-coherence tracking and spectral-analysis modules for
  streaming anomaly detection.
- GitHub Language Analysis Platform: data-analysis capstone across 1,200+
  GitHub repositories — six-notebook pipeline (ANOVA-backed language
  comparison, correlation analysis, 3D visualization) feeding a React/Plotly
  dashboard. https://git-hub-language-capstone.vercel.app/
- Enterprise Predictive Analytics Platform: classification engine, 78%
  cross-validated accuracy over 200k+ records, REST API + TypeScript
  dashboard.
- Traffic Safety & Infrastructure Optimization: spatio-temporal analysis of
  200k+ collision records informing a $1.2M infrastructure investment.

## Services
- Operational analytics engagements (SQL, Python, BI dashboards, forecasts,

  Readyfuels)

  Nous Research; concrete artifact: the NIGHTMARE penetration-testing suite)
- Local-first AI systems (JCLAW, kairos, agent/MCP infrastructure)
- Systems audits and decision architecture for founders and ops leaders

## Active / Open-Source Projects
- JCLAW: local-first LLM runtime with multi-provider routing, persistent
  sessions, conversation branching, agentic loops, and MCP dual-mode
  operation.
- kairos: local-first knowledge workspace — parses docs/code/logs by
  structure and traces concepts via explicit, typed relations; zero
  embeddings, zero network calls.
- Hermes plugin (for Nous Research): three-subagent stack (codegen,
  red-team, resource-gathering) under a persistent SOUL.md identity layer
  with OpenRouter routing.
- WVRTP Facility Inspection System (for Readyfuels): React/Vite/TypeScript
  app on Vercel with QR-driven capture, browser geolocation, Power Automate
  pipelines, and a companion 1,135-formula safety + KPI Excel workbook.
  Case study: https://jacobcdsmith.github.io/blog/wvrtp-satellites-to-street-signs/
- Wave Analyzer (OmniWave): Android real-time audio/RF spectrum analyzer
  with AI signal classification.
- agent-flow-canvas: browser-based visual builder for AI agent workflows.
- UNIHIKER K10 skill package + ESP32-S3 firmware: embedded/edge work.
